run_metadata.coverage_summary: Attempted the full source universe (Tier 1 core government, Tier 2 broader public sector / GBE, Tier 3 private). Direct page retrieval remained fully blocked again this run: WebFetch returned HTTP 403 for every external URL tested, including the control host en.wikipedia.org, and the agent-proxy status endpoint confirmed the org egress policy denies CONNECT to external hosts (no relay failures logged). Per proxy policy, 403 org-policy denials were not retried or routed around. Consequently no tender detail page, listing page, RSS/API feed or specification document could be opened directly; all capture is from WebSearch, cross-verified across multiple independent queries, with each opportunity's existence, buyer and close date corroborated by at least two searches and any item whose close date fell on or before 2026-07-25 (or could not be corroborated) rejected. Three genuinely new currently-active opportunities were captured this run: City of Sydney EOI for a Sydney Christmas Trees & Decorations 2028-2032 design concept (EOI closes 10 Aug 2026, via the City's TenderLink e-tendering portal); CSIRO RFT CSIRORFT2026019 Ground Maintenance Services for CSIRO Managed Sites VIC Metro (closes 17 Aug 2026 2:00pm ACT, full scope + contact recovered from cross-verified AusTender/tender-index snippets); and a Transport for NSW HW4 Log Creek Pavement Rehabilitation Stage 2 'Culvert Unit Supply' package (closes 4 Aug 2026) - a distinct package alongside the previously-seen Stage 2 kerb-installation item. One Greater Western Water early-tender-advice notice (Hopkins Road Water Main Section 2, RFT intended for release Aug 2026) was recorded as an upcoming/market-sounding procurement. Two previously-seen opportunities were re-verified as still open and carried forward with enriched detail: Western Power 'Clean Energy Link' PCMS EOI (closes 31 Jul 2026, closing-soon; PCMS reference + deliverables recovered from Western Power's own opportunity page and reneweconomy) and DCCEEW ATM_2026_6786 GEMS verification-testing laboratory panel (closes 12 Aug 2026, still current in this run's AusTender index). One genuinely new buyer-originated source was recorded (Ampol Procurement). Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network, plus BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Santos, Coles, Woolworths, Qantas, banks, telcos, and energy majors Ampol/Viva/BlueScope) was checked: no publicly-advertised Australian RFx was visible without a supplier login, so no corporate tender was captured (portals remain registration-gated or invitation-only). Zero tenders were fabricated.
gaps: Direct page retrieval fully blocked again this run. WebFetch returned HTTP 403 for every external URL including the control host en.wikipedia.org; the agent-proxy status endpoint confirmed the org egress policy denies CONNECT to external hosts (recentRelayFailures empty). The proxy README instructs not to retry 403/407 policy denials. Consequence: no ATM/RFT detail page, listing page, RSS/API feed or specification document could be opened; all detail is limited to cross-verified WebSearch snippets. Source-document deliverables/requirements extraction was not possible this run.

City of Sydney Christmas Trees & Decorations 2028-2032 design-concept EOI: title, buyer, EOI nature and closing date (10 Aug 2026) corroborated across two independent searches, but the exact tender reference number, publish date, exact closing time, evaluation criteria and the TenderLink detail page could not be opened (403 wall). Recorded at headline level; a publish-date field returned by one search summary ('3 Aug 2026') was treated as unreliable and not recorded.

Transport for NSW HW4 Log Creek Pavement Rehabilitation Stage 2 - Culvert Unit Supply: scope and closing date (4 Aug 2026) corroborated, but the exact RFT/tender ID and full documents remain unrecoverable behind the 403 wall (buy.nsw detail page could not be opened).

Western Power 'Clean Energy Link' PCMS EOI: existence, buyer, scope/deliverables and EOI due date (31 Jul 2026) corroborated across Western Power's own PCMS opportunity page and reneweconomy industry news, but the exact EOI reference, evaluation criteria and contract value are behind the registration-gated + 403-blocked Opportunities Hub. Closing within days (closing-soon).

Greater Western Water Hopkins Road Water Main Section 2 and Melton Recycled Water Plant Potable Water Service Upgrade are 'early tender advice' items GWW/its consultants intend to release as RFTs in Aug 2026 - not yet open. Only the Hopkins Road item was recorded (as an upcoming/market-sounding notice with published scope); Melton potable upgrade was noted but not recorded as a tender (no open notice yet).

Search snippets again recycled closed/stale AusTender items as if current (e.g. ATM_2026_6551 Energy Pipeline Data Services, closed 8 Jun 2026). LCD-26-0030 (Army Innovation Day RFI, closes 27 Jul 2026, participation invitations issued from 17 Aug 2026) and OPC-2026-03 (printing services, closes 29 Jul) close within days and were left carried forward at headline level from prior runs rather than re-recorded, as their documents were not re-extractable behind the 403 wall.

Tier-1 state/territory portals (buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) were reachable only as landing pages via search; individual open tenders generally could not be drilled into or date-verified behind the 403 wall, so apart from the TfNSW HW4 Culvert package no new state-portal opportunity could be confirmed at a trustworthy level of detail this run. Tenders WA also had a planned outage window (Sat 25 Jul 2026, 08:00-12:00).

Tier-3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network, plus BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Santos, Coles, Woolworths, Qantas, banks, telcos, Ampol, Viva Energy, BlueScope, Incitec Pivot): checked as required. No publicly-advertised Australian RFx was visible without a supplier login; corporate opportunities remain registration-gated or invitation-only, so none were captured as tenders. Relevant corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources (Ampol newly this run).
recommended_seed_additions: Ampol - Procurement (https://www.ampol.com.au/about-ampol/procurement): buyer-originated corporate procurement entry point for a >$1bn/yr Australian fuels/energy buyer; e-sourcing platform unconfirmed, worth a periodic check and a supplier-registration pass for authenticated runs.

Greater Western Water - Current Tenders (illion TenderLink, https://portal.tenderlink.com/greaterwesternwater/alltenders/): Victorian GBE water utility publishing RFTs and early tender advice directly; carries a pipeline of DN600 water-main and recycled-water plant works around Melton/Melbourne's west in 2026.

tenders.title: Ground Maintenance Services for CSIRO Managed Sites VIC Metro
tenders.buyer: Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO)
tenders.description: CSIRO seeks suitably qualified and experienced service providers to deliver grounds maintenance and landscaping services across its Victoria metropolitan managed sites.
tenders.deliverables_summary: The contractor is to provide comprehensive preventive and reactive grounds maintenance and landscaping services so that all outdoor areas at CSIRO's nominated VIC metro sites are maintained to a high standard of safety and presentation.
key_deliverables: Maintenance of outdoor areas to a high standard of safety and presentation across the Clayton Precinct, Aspendale and Werribee sites
tenders.scope_of_work: Grounds maintenance and landscaping services at CSIRO's Clayton Precinct (Clayton, Clayton North and Notting Hill), Aspendale, and Werribee (Sneydes Road and South Road) sites.
tenders.eligibility: Open to suitably qualified and experienced grounds maintenance service providers.
tenders.delivery_location: CSIRO Clayton Precinct (Clayton, Clayton North, Notting Hill), Aspendale, and Werribee (Sneydes Road and South Road), Victoria
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM CSIRORFT2026019 listing, cross-verified across multiple independent tender-index snippets (TenderTracker, Tendor, Tenders.net, tenderhub); AusTender detail page itself was 403-blocked to direct fetch this run.
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch of AusTender/CSIRO for open RFTs closing Aug 2026; the CSIRO procurement is buyer-originated and published on the Commonwealth AusTender portal. Scope, sites, closing time and contact email were consistent across two independent searches.
tenders.notes: Well-corroborated detail. Exact contract term/value and evaluation criteria not published in the accessible snippets; detail page could not be opened behind the 403 wall.

tenders.title: Design Concept for Sydney Christmas Trees and Decorations 2028-2032 (EOI)
tenders.description: Expression of interest to develop and evolve an original Sydney Christmas design concept that will form the basis and inspiration for the City's Christmas trees and decorations from 2028 to 2032, including the design of Martin Place.
tenders.deliverables_summary: The successful respondent will develop an original, evolving Sydney Christmas design concept to inspire and underpin the City of Sydney's festive trees and decorations across the 2028-2032 seasons, including a design for Martin Place.
key_deliverables: Original Sydney Christmas design concept for the 2028-2032 period
Design direction for the City's Christmas trees and decorations
Design concept for Martin Place festive installation
tenders.submission_method: Lodge via City of Sydney e-tendering portal (TenderLink)
tenders.delivery_location: City of Sydney local government area, NSW
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch for NSW/City of Sydney current tenders; corroborated across two independent searches (australiantenders.com.au issuer page and City of Sydney TenderLink current-tenders listing). City of Sydney publishes its own tenders on its buyer-hosted TenderLink e-tendering portal.
tenders.notes: Headline level only - the TenderLink detail page and tender reference could not be opened behind the 403 wall. Closing date 10 Aug 2026 corroborated across two searches; a 'publish 3 Aug 2026' value returned by one search summary is inconsistent with a 10 Aug close and was treated as unreliable and not recorded.

Construction, safety and health oversight and monitoring

tenders.delivery_location: Western Australia (South West Interconnected System / Clean Energy Link corridors)

tenders.notes: Closing within days (EOI due 31 Jul 2026). Exact EOI reference, evaluation criteria and value remain behind the registration-gated + 403-blocked Opportunities Hub.
